newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $65.25 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $65.25 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers nd heifers were steady in a light test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 3,000 head slaughter steers and 1,000 heifers; following weekly movement of 69,800 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 65.00-65.25. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 63.25.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 65.00-65.25.
Confirmed - 4,000 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 32,500
